links.comparator_used: Reasoning-only generation (step-by-step reasoning with no rule-based trajectory editing)
links.outcome: Protocol compliance on SSNHL, adherence on the conductive contrast condition, and balanced accuracy
links.effect: SSNHL compliance rose to 83.5% and conductive-case adherence to 77.9%. Balanced accuracy rose from 42.0% under reasoning-only generation to 80.7%.
links.tradeoff: The authors report limitations from rule coverage, trigger reliability, and persistent diagnosis-first generation dynamics.
links.quote: Local trajectory editing increased SSNHL compliance to 83.5% and conductive-case adherence to 77.9%, raising balanced accuracy from 42.0% under reasoning-only generation to 80.7%.

links.outcome: Protocol-compliant outcomes for SSNHL versus acceptance on the conductive contrast condition
links.effect: SSNHL compliant outcomes fell from 54.5% to 25.1%. Acceptance on the conductive contrast condition rose from 1.6% to 58.9%.
links.tradeoff: Step-by-step reasoning shifted errors rather than eliminating them. SSNHL compliance fell, and the conductive condition was accepted more often.
links.quote: In the benchmark, step-by-step reasoning shifted rather than eliminated errors: compliant outcomes for SSNHL decreased from 54.5% under unguided generation to 25.1%, while acceptance on the conductive contrast condition increased from 1.6% to 58.9%.

design_hint: runtime rule-guided trajectory editing (output guardrail) for protocol compliance
